description: SereneDB test-config for the vendored duckdb_azure test suite. Entries are known SereneDB divergences -- see tests/duckdb/README.md.

skip_tests.reason: There is no runtime extension loader: SereneDB builds with DISABLE_EXTENSION_LOAD and links its extension set statically, so every `INSTALL 'az://...'` and `INSTALL 'abfss://...'` in this file reports that instead of the Azure error it asserts. The whole file is about installing an extension through the Azure file systems. Same reason as the core-suite LOAD and INSTALL paths, tracked in issue #887.
